python - <<'PY'
import warnings
from marshmallow import Schema, fields, missing
from marshmallow_jsonschema import JSONSchema
from marshmallow.warnings import RemovedInMarshmallow4Warning
with warnings.catch_warnings():
    warnings.simplefilter('error', RemovedInMarshmallow4Warning)
    for cls in (fields.Field, fields.Raw):
        f = cls(load_default=lambda: 12, dump_default=lambda: 34)
        assert f.deserialize(missing) == 12
        assert f.serialize('value', {}) == 34
        assert f.deserialize(5) == 5
        assert f.serialize('value', {'value': 6}) == 6
        assert f.metadata == {}
        assert 'dump_default=' in repr(f) and 'load_default=' in repr(f)
        f.load_default, f.dump_default = 7, 8
        assert f.deserialize(missing) == 7
        assert f.serialize('value', {}) == 8
        assert cls(load_default=None).deserialize(None) is None
        try:
            cls(required=True, load_default=0)
        except ValueError as exc:
            assert 'load_default' in str(exc)
        else:
            raise AssertionError('required field accepted a load default')
    constant = fields.Constant(5, load_default=6, dump_default=7)
    assert constant.deserialize(missing) == constant.deserialize(123) == 5
    assert constant.serialize('value', {}) == constant.serialize('value', {'value': 123}) == 5
    class Child(Schema):
        value = fields.Integer()
    class Parent(Schema):
        raw = fields.Raw(load_default=1, dump_default=2)
        child = fields.Nested(Child, load_default={'value': 3}, dump_default={'value': 4})
    assert Parent().load({}) == {'raw': 1, 'child': {'value': 3}}
    assert Parent().dump({}) == {'raw': 2, 'child': {'value': 4}}
    props = JSONSchema().dump(Parent())['definitions']['Parent']['properties']
    assert props['raw']['default'] == 2
    assert props['child']['default'] == {'value': 4}
with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as caught:
    warnings.simplefilter('always', RemovedInMarshmallow4Warning)
    f = fields.Raw(missing=1, default=2)
    assert f.load_default == f.missing == 1
    assert f.dump_default == f.default == 2
    f.missing, f.default = 3, 4
    assert f.deserialize(missing) == 3
    assert f.serialize('value', {}) == 4
    f = fields.Raw(load_default=0, missing=1, dump_default=False, default=2)
    assert f.load_default == 0 and f.dump_default is False
    assert len(caught) == 8
print('New API, legacy aliases, and warning-free consumer integration checks passed.')
PY
